Specialists in voltage control and regulation

More than 60 years designing and manufacturing toroidal transformers, drives and voltage stabilizers for general industry.
We also manufacture load benches and resistors for factories and industrial buildings.

More Information

Custom manufacturing

Do you need a custom design or fabrication?

We manufacture all types of components for voltage regulation and control.
Every industry has unique needs in the regulation and transformation of electrical voltage. Having custom-designed solutions makes a difference in the performance, efficiency and safety of your installations. Our team is ready to advise you every step of the way, from selecting the right equipment to integrating it into your electrical systems. If you need information about our products, want a customized solution or have any technical questions, we are here to help you.

We manufacture customized equipment for voltage regulation, offering advanced solutions for the industry.

items.full_text:
Electrical transformer regulations in Europe

Electrical transformers and technical regulations in spain and europe
The European electricity sector, with special emphasis on countries such as Spain, is becoming increasingly regulated with regard to the safe and efficient use of transformers. Regulations on electrical transformers have become stricter due to the growing demand for energy safety, environmental sustainability and loss reduction. Added to this is the advance of industrial technologies that demand rigorous compliance with standards such as EN 50588-1 and the regulations of EU Regulation 2019/1783, related to the energy efficiency of distribution transformers. The competent authorities in Spain and Europe require all installations to have certified equipment and protection systems that guarantee optimum operation. In this context, companies dedicated to energy infrastructure must have products and specialized advice to ensure the correct interpretation and application of these regulations.
Electrical transformer regulations not only cover design and manufacturing, but also regulate critical aspects such as installation, maintenance, noise emission levels and efficiency under different load conditions. Failure to comply with these requirements can lead to penalties, asset immobilization and even supply problems. Electrical infrastructure design and implementation companies therefore need strategic allies who have a thorough understanding of European technical requirements. From urban electrical substations to large energy transmission networks, the right choice of transformer and regulatory compliance become the cornerstones of any sustainable energy project in Europe. Product reliability and regulatory expertise are more than optional: they are an unavoidable technical and legal imperative.

European manufacturers of electrical transformers vs. Asian imports
In a market dominated by more complex and demanding requirements, there is a growing shortage of European manufacturers developing transformers that are truly aligned with European standards. This situation opens the door to the entry of imported products, especially of Chinese origin, whose technical characteristics and levels of compliance are, in many cases, insufficient. Although these products often offer highly competitive prices, their long-term performance generates frequent discussions between installers, maintenance technicians and regulatory bodies. Disparity in traceability, low energy efficiency parameters and construction materials below the standards required by the EU are just some of the reasons why technical and regulatory risks increase when opting for these products.
In this scenario, Torivac drives stand out as one of the few solutions from a manufacturer with a strong European presence, both for their level of innovation and their solid regulatory profile. For companies operating in high electrical demand environments, such as companies involved in the construction of substations or medium voltage networks, the choice of non-approved devices can jeopardize the completeness of the project, prolong connection times and, in extreme cases, force replacements due to regulatory non-compliance. Unable to guarantee direct compatibility with electrical transformer regulations, these low-cost products become a threat to operational stability rather than a solution. For this reason, verification of origin, certification and technical support are indispensable elements for any company that intends to operate efficiently in Europe.

Consulting and regulatory compliance with technical solutions certified by torivac
Torivac has consolidated its reputation as a strategic partner for companies seeking to meet high-level technical requirements for transformers. Its offer includes detailed advice on regulatory compliance at every stage of the process: from project definition to on-site execution. Unlike competitors who rely on generic solutions or limited advice, Torivac provides comprehensive technical support focused on a thorough understanding of electrical transformer regulations, rigorously adapted to the requirements of the Spanish and European market. This proactive approach allows to reduce errors during installation and to anticipate audits or inspections by regulatory bodies.
Torivac’s strength also lies in its products, designed to fit perfectly within the parameters of the European Regulation on energy efficiency and dielectric strength, guaranteeing safety, performance and durability. Its line of drives has been specifically developed under standards that respond to the current challenges of the energy sector. In addition, each solution is backed by technical documentation recognized by European certifying bodies, giving contractors a confidence that can hardly be found with suppliers outside the European regulatory context. For infrastructure companies looking to protect their investments, comply with regulations and ensure operational continuity, Torivac is undoubtedly a superior choice for both the quality of its components and the specialized expertise of its technical team.

Ensuring regulatory compliance is a sustainable competitive advantage
Ensuring compliance with regulations on electrical transformers is not only a legal obligation, but a factor that makes a competitive difference in an increasingly regulated and demanding energy market. The ability to deliver complete, safe and compliant electrical projects has a direct impact on the technical reputation of any company dedicated to energy infrastructure. Optimizing installation time, avoiding regulatory sanctions and having products with high technical performance are advantages that impact both costs and the quality of service offered to end customers.
Relying on suppliers like Torivac represents much more than just acquiring electrical components. It means accessing an ecosystem of solutions designed for complex regulatory environments, with an approach that combines strategic advice, up-to-date regulatory knowledge and certified products. Companies looking to raise their technical standards and position themselves as industry leaders find in Torivac the ideal partner to ensure success, compliance and sustainability. The right choice not only protects the infrastructure; it also ensures that each project leaves a footprint of excellence. Staying within the regulatory framework is non-negotiable, it is the way to lead in an energy environment that transforms every day.

items.full_text:
Maintenance of electrical transformers

The importance of electrical transformer maintenance in Europe
Ensuring a stable and secure energy supply is today a growing need in many industrial sectors in Europe. In countries such as Spain, improving the energy infrastructure is a constant priority.
In this context, the maintenance of electrical transformers takes on special relevance. This equipment is essential for distributing and transforming electrical energy at different voltage levels.
As industrial demand grows, so do the demands on transformers. They must operate under optimum conditions to avoid unplanned shutdowns, costly failures or safety hazards.
In industries such as chemical, pharmaceutical or food, regulatory standards are strict and production times are carefully scheduled. In these environments, relying on transformers without proper maintenance can put the integrity of the entire system at risk.
Therefore, maintenance should not be considered a corrective action in the event of a breakdown. It is a continuous strategy that prolongs equipment life, optimizes energy efficiency and prevents incidents.
In this scenario, power companies in Europe need reliable partners. They are looking for suppliers that offer specialized technical solutions, with in-depth knowledge and proven experience in the care and prevention of these key electrical assets.

pressure on the market and doubts about the quality of Asian manufacturers
Competition in the electrical transformer sector has increased significantly with the entry of Asian manufacturers, especially those of Chinese origin. These tend to offer attractive prices, although they often sacrifice quality standards, durability and efficiency.
For European companies operating in industries with high energy requirements, such as food, pharmaceuticals or chemicals, this difference represents an unacceptable risk. In these sectors, a power failure can affect production, safety or even regulatory compliance.
The maintenance of electrical transformers is no longer a purely technical task. It becomes a strategic issue linked to productivity, industrial safety and sustainability of operations.
Today, Europe has few manufacturers that meet the standards required by the most regulated sectors. This shortage increases the need to work with suppliers capable of guaranteeing high quality components and offering specialized technical support.
This is where the real differences between a transformer that barely meets the minimum and one that offers reliable long-term performance become apparent.
While Asian equipment tends to have more frequent failures and variable efficiency metrics, companies like Torivac focus on developing robust technologies, adapted to European regulations and designed to operate sustainably for years.
Choosing the wrong supplier can not only result in repair costs. It can also result in regulatory non-compliance, line stoppages or loss of sensitive materials.
Therefore, technical reliability, after-sales support and preventive practices should be fundamental criteria when making electrical maintenance decisions.
More than low prices, companies need solutions that ensure operational continuity and long-term improvement of their energy systems.

Torivac as a strategic partner in efficiency and maintenance
In the current scenario, having a supplier that not only provides quality equipment, but also offers preventive and corrective maintenance, becomes a key factor. This type of service provides a differential value that can have a direct impact on a company’s productivity and operational stability.
Torivac positions itself as a company specialized in the maintenance of electrical transformers. Its services are designed for industries that cannot afford unplanned shutdowns or risks derived from electrical failures.
Torivac’s methodology is based on a detailed analysis of the condition of each transformer.
Based on this information, it implements individualized maintenance plans that optimize energy efficiency and reduce losses caused by overheating, dielectric leakage, overloads or aging of internal components.
Its experience in the maintenance of electrical transformers is complemented by a highly trained technical team. This group of professionals understands the specific needs of sectors such as the chemical, pharmaceutical and food industries.
In these environments, any voltage variation can affect critical processes, alter quality standards or even generate health and regulatory risks.
That is why Torivac offers maintenance that goes beyond a simple overhaul. Its approach guarantees operational continuity with the lowest possible margin of error.
Services include thermography diagnostics, overhaul of cooling systems, adjustment of internal connections, dielectric oil analysis and complete electrical testing.
Each action seeks to ensure the integrity of the transformer at all levels.
These preventive practices not only extend the useful life of the equipment, but also foster a corporate culture oriented towards energy excellence and the protection of technical capital.
Companies that have relied on Torivac report significant improvements in energy consumption and in the stability of their production processes.
The results validate the positive impact of working with a supplier capable of meeting the highest operational standards in Europe.

More than a technical service, a strategic decision for the future
Maintenance of electrical transformers goes far beyond a technical obligation on the industrial agenda. In an environment where energy efficiency determines competitiveness and sustainability, anticipating failures is key.
Ensuring the continuous performance of electrical systems becomes a decisive factor for any company.
Investing in preventive and corrective maintenance with a reliable technology partner is not just an operational action. It is a direct investment in business continuity and growth.
Torivac does not limit itself to offering maintenance contracts tailored to the needs of each client. It also acts as a technical consultant who accompanies operationally and strategically each step of the process.
From service implementation to detailed transformer condition reports, the company demonstrates an ongoing commitment to quality, safety and innovation.
This approach makes it possible to anticipate incidents, reduce energy consumption and maintain performance indicators within the parameters required by European standards.
We invite companies in the energy and industrial sector looking for precision, reliability and professional technical support to consider Torivac as their strategic partner in electrical transformer maintenance.
The difference is not only in avoiding a failure, but in empowering the electric infrastructure as an engine of development. Choosing well today means staying competitive tomorrow.

What is a transformer for? Discover its key function

How transformers work in industrial and commercial environments
Understanding what a transformer is for is essential for any industry or company that manages complex electrical systems, especially in areas such as Spain and other European countries, where the demand for energy-efficient equipment is not only growing, but also increasingly oriented towards safe and durable solutions. A transformer is used to adapt the voltage of the electrical current according to the specific needs of an installation, making it possible to supply power from heavy machinery to lighter applications, always maintaining operational stability and minimizing energy losses. This critical equipment acts as a reliable intermediary between the power source and the systems that require a specific voltage for optimal operation.
In the industrial and commercial sectors, where electrical networks are often subject to high and changing loads, knowing what a transformer is used for helps prevent serious problems such as voltage drops or dangerous overheating. In Europe, where stringent regulations on energy consumption and electrical safety prevail, having a well-dimensioned transformer adapted to specific needs has a direct impact on a company’s operational continuity. This is particularly critical in countries such as Germany, France and Spain, where industrial environments rely on robust, safe solutions manufactured to high quality standards.

Europe’s scarce supply and the risks of importing low-quality transformers
Currently, there is an alarming lack of high-quality European transformer manufacturers, which has led to market saturation by importers of Chinese equipment. While these products may be offered at lower prices, their durability, stability and compatibility with the technical requirements of European systems leave much to be desired. This situation creates a considerable problem for sectors such as data centers, where the equipment handles critical electrical loads and cannot be allowed to fail. A transformer with low-quality components does not meet the technical requirements or the expected service life, generating operational risks, higher maintenance costs and, in many cases, compromising the safety of workers and infrastructure.
Knowing what a transformer is for is not only limited to technical knowledge of its function, but also involves understanding the need to choose suppliers that offer proven quality, compatibility with European standards and efficient technical support. Data centers, which are particularly sensitive to voltage fluctuations and constant energy consumption, are absolutely dependent on the reliability of the transformer powering their equipment. For this reason, every purchasing decision must be approached with solid information and a clear commitment to European quality or to brands that, although not local, guarantee superior standards. At this point, making the right choice can make the difference between maintaining continuous operation or facing millions of dollars in losses due to unexpected interruptions.

With extensive experience in the manufacture of transformers for European markets, Torivac delivers confidence in each of its products, backed by a professional service that accompanies each installation from concept to final implementation.

Torivac at Matelec 2024 – Exploring the market and strengthening connections

Our annual visit to Matelec
As in every edition, some members of the Torivac team made a trip to Madrid to attend
Matelec 2024
. This fair is already a tradition in our calendar because it is the key meeting point for the electrical and technological sector. In addition to seeing the latest innovations, it gives us the opportunity to catch up with customers, suppliers, partners and explore how the market is currently moving.
This year, however, the experience was not what we expected. Although we found some interesting products/booths, there were also some organizational problems that affected the flow of the event.

New trends and solutions at a glance
At Torivac, we always find it a great opportunity to appreciate the innovations in the industry. Companies were showing their technologies and specific solutions for voltage regulation. However, we did not have the opportunity to appreciate the ideas they had to offer, as we felt that the distribution of the stands and the management of the spaces was something that affected a lot. Some areas seemed a bit cluttered, and that made it difficult to concentrate on the presentations and products.
Despite these difficulties, this visit has been key for us. Seeing firsthand what other players in the sector are doing helps us to keep up to date, anticipate trends and consider new ideas that we could integrate into our own company.

Meeting with customers and suppliers: A key issue
One of the highlights of Matelec is the opportunity to meet face to face with our customers and suppliers. However, this year it was not as easy as on other occasions. In several booths, we noticed that the staff seemed to be a bit overwhelmed and sometimes it was complicated to get the attention we were looking for to go deeper into certain topics. On the other hand, the space of the event was much smaller than in other years, which generated more discomfort and overwhelm among visitors and staff.
Reflections for the future
Although this edition of Matelec did not meet expectations, at Torivac we value the experience it has given us in other editions.
Matelec is, in the end, an opportunity to learn, reflect and see where we can improve. It allows us to see the market from another perspective and motivates us to move forward with new ideas. So we hope that the organization has noticed these mistakes and we can fix them for future editions.
If you have been interested in this article, you can find out more about our company
here
.
We look forward to welcoming you!

Torivac in Beyond Catalonia

Beyond Catalonia opens doors to global trade
Torivac will be present at the Beyond Catalona event organized by ACCIÓ – Agència per la Competitivitat de l’Empresa.
Beyond Catalonia for Torivac represented a strategic opportunity to strengthen our presence in international markets. This event, organized by ACCIÓ – Agència per la Competitivitat de l’Empresa, was held at the World Trade Center in Barcelona and has established itself as the key meeting point for Catalan companies with a global vision. Beyond Catalonia is the evolution of more than 30 editions of the Internationalization Week and remains an essential platform to explore new business opportunities in a highly competitive environment.
Participating in events of this magnitude allows us not only to expand our network of contacts, but also to obtain valuable information on trends, regulations and international market demands. At Torivac, we know that innovation and expansion are fundamental to continue offering quality solutions in voltage regulation and electrical transformation.

What is Beyond Catalonia?
Beyond Catalonia is a business event organized by ACCIÓ – Agència per la Competitivitat de l’Empresa, which aims to boost the internationalization of Catalan companies. This forum brings together companies, foreign trade experts and representatives of international markets to explore new business opportunities, analyze global trends and facilitate the connection with strategic partners.

AI for trade management and international expansion, within the main topics
One of the central themes was the importance of creating an international market intelligence unit, providing methodologies to analyze trends and opportunities in different sectors. We discussed the effectiveness of Google Ads as a digital channel for customer acquisition in new markets, evaluating its profitability and segmentation.
On the other hand, artificial intelligence played a prominent role with the presentation on AI in the management of international B2B trade, where its applications in automation and optimization of business processes were explored.
In addition, we have deepened on the concept of the customer journey (process where a customer discovers a company and makes a purchase, and then becomes a recurring customer) and its internationalization and how to structure an effective promotion plan.
We presented various financing tools and official support for exporters, facilitating access to key resources that drive the international expansion of companies. Internationalization requires economic and strategic resources to meet the challenges of foreign trade, from the initial investment in promotion and distribution to the management of financial risks associated with global transactions.
Another essential point was access to information platforms and specialized advice, such as those offered by ACCIÓ and the Chamber of Commerce, which provide market research, trade missions and personalized advice on legal, tax and logistics aspects. These tools enable companies to reduce the learning curve in foreign markets and optimize their entry strategy.

Consolidating a new expansion strategy
Torivac’s track record in Europe has proven the high value of our products, such as voltage regulators, toroidal transformers, autotransformers and load banks. Our technology has been key in multiple industries, ensuring a stable and efficient power supply. However, growth knows no boundaries and we are ready to take the next step.
Beyond Catalonia gave us the opportunity to explore emerging markets and strengthen our presence outside Europe. One of our main potential targets is America, which has a growing demand for voltage regulation solutions in the industrial, technological and energy sectors. Our aim is to bring our experience and quality to companies seeking to optimize their electrical infrastructure with efficient products tailored to their needs.
This meeting provided us with the tools and knowledge necessary to design an effective internationalization strategy. We were able to connect with experts in foreign trade, analyze global trends and define the best way to consolidate our expansion.
As a company with many years of experience, we believe that the key to success lies in preparation and the ability to adapt to new environments. Beyond Catalonia is the ideal scenario to strengthen our foundations and move forward with a firm step towards a global future. We are convinced that this event will allow us to continue growing and offering innovative solutions and new alliances to more clients around the world.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators.
We have nearly 60 years of experience in the industry, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest standards in the industry.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. Ensuring a stable power supply is critical for any industry. Power surges and dips can cause equipment failures, reduce operating efficiency and increase maintenance costs. Voltage stabilizers ensure stable supply and cost reduction

Power consumption in large infrastructures directly impacts the profitability and operational efficiency of any industry. Constant power surges and dips not only lead to equipment failures, but also increase electrical expenditure and maintenance costs. To avoid these problems, high-performance voltage stabilizers are vital to ensure stable and optimized power flow.
They ensure the continuity of power supply and the protection of industrial and commercial infrastructure. Our voltage stabilizers maintain a constant energy distribution, avoiding overloads and prolonging the life of the equipment.

What is a voltage stabilizer and what is its function?
A voltage stabilizer is a device designed to maintain a constant voltage level in an electrical system, compensating for variations in the supply network that could affect the operation of connected equipment. Its main function is to protect electrical and electronic devices from voltage surges and dips, preventing damage from surges or voltage drops that can cause failures, reduced performance or even irreparable breakdowns.
These devices are essential in applications where voltage stability is critical, such as in hospitals, data centers, laboratories, manufacturing industries and telecommunications systems. By ensuring a stable power supply, voltage stabilizers optimize equipment performance and extend equipment life.

What is the difference between a voltage protector and a voltage stabilizer?
The voltage stabilizer is equipped with a transformer that has several outputs. This allows it to modify the voltage output to different levels, depending on the needs of the moment. Thus, when the input voltage varies outside normal ranges, the stabilizer does not simply disconnect devices, but actively adjusts the voltage. In doing so, it ensures that your equipment always receives the exact amount of power it needs, no more and no less.
Unlike the stabilizer, which continuously adjusts the voltage, the voltage protector kicks in when it detects an overvoltage (or undervoltage) that exceeds a safe threshold. At that critical instant, it acts quickly to block the excessive energy. You can think of it as a fast and sensitive switch, capable of disconnecting power to protect your equipment in milliseconds.

Why choose a voltage stabilizer?
A voltage stabilizer will not disconnect your device while in use, but will maintain a constant voltage level over time. For example, if your area experiences frequent power surges and dips, a voltage stabilizer would be the right choice, as it keeps the power output stable.
In addition, it contributes to infrastructure protection, reduces costs, improves energy efficiency and ensures operational continuity without risk or interruption.

How does it benefit large energy infrastructures?
Voltage stabilizers play a key role in reducing energy consumption by optimizing the use of electricity and minimizing unnecessary losses. One of the main problems in industrial environments is voltage instability, which can lead to excessive energy consumption and affect equipment performance. These devices ensure that the voltage supplied to machinery is maintained within optimum levels, avoiding overconsumption caused by electrical fluctuations.
Implementing voltage regulators helps to comply with energy regulations and improve the energy efficiency rating of facilities. By consuming only the energy needed for each process, companies can reduce operating costs, improve productivity and contribute to a more sustainable and environmentally responsible industrial model.

The battery dischargers we manufacture at Torivac are key tools in the electrical and electronic world. items.full_text:
What is a Voltage Variator?

At
Torivac
, we are experts in all types of electronic elements and components, and today we want to talk to you about one of the most common devices in this sector: the
voltage variator
. Variable autotransformers, commonly known as voltage variators, allow you to modulate the amplitude of the input sine wave, enabling continuous voltage variation without changing the input frequency and with virtually zero harmonic distortion.

Types of Voltage Regulators

Voltage regulators can come in three different forms:

Voltage variators without mechanical protection (IP00)
: These are mainly intended for industrial environments where the user integrates the variator into their system.
Enclosed variators
: These are suitable for domestic use or in industrial environments ready for use without prior installation.
Turnkey projects
: Our engineering team combines voltage variators or variable autotransformers with other components like transformers, load banks, rectifiers, control drivers, or other elements, providing tailored solutions for each customer.

How to Calculate the Power You Need for Your Voltage Variator or Adjustable Autotransformer
An adjustable autotransformer consists of a single, orderly winding, with a cursor moving along it to select the desired voltage.
The relationship between the magnetic section of the core and the wire diameter in voltage variators is crucial in calculating optimal performance, preventing overheating, and maintaining a competitive price.
In variable autotransformers, we must define the
maximum operating current
in continuous operation and the
maximum regulation voltage
. Based on these two parameters, we can determine the required power, the magnetic core section, and the winding conductor diameter.
Once these parameters are defined, the appropriate voltage variator format can be chosen for continuous operation, 100% load, 24/7.
When selecting the power of variable autotransformers, it is important to consider that when a variator is installed in an enclosure or cabinet, the ventilation must match the heat dissipation, or the variator windings should be oversized to operate at a lower thermal load.
If you’re not sure whether this component would help meet your needs, don’t worry! We are at your full disposal. Ask us, and we’ll be happy to
assist you!

items.full_text:
The importance of the toroidal transformer in industry

Maximize performance and reduce operating costs with our high-efficiency transformers.
At Torivac we specialize in offering high quality industrial transformers, both toroidal and conventional transformers, custom designed to meet the specific needs of our customers.
These products stand out for their energy efficiency, durability and reliability, with the confidence that comes from a company with more than 60 years of experience. This equipment reduces operating costs and improves the stability of the electrical systems of any business. Our strength for the design of these transformers? We use advanced technology, such as 3D modeling, to ensure high quality and precision products.
In addition, our transformers contribute to environmental sustainability by minimizing energy consumption and carbon footprint. We have a strong commitment and vocation for continuous innovation to offer advanced solutions that exceed our customers’ expectations, without neglecting the ecological aspect.

Which is the most suitable toroidal transformer for your company?
Expert advice is important for an informed and efficient choice. However, there are a number of key considerations that will always help you choose the perfect equipment.
To choose the right toroidal transformer for your company, it is essential to consider aspects such as power requirements, load capacity, quality and energy efficiency, compatibility with electrical equipment, design and installation, as well as to review the relevant technical specifications.
Of course, feel free to consult any questions with electrical experts or electrical engineers can provide personalized guidance. Our team can help you with this. In this way, we guarantee an informed and optimal selection of the transformer that meets your company’s specific energy needs.

Difference between toroidal and conventional transformers: efficiency, design and applications
Unpacking the relationship between cost, efficiency and performance to meet specific energy requirements.
Toroidal and conventional transformers, although both are valid, differ in design and efficiency. Toroidal transformers, fortunately for your company, have a circular core that minimizes losses and noise generation, being more compact and efficient, but they are usually more expensive.
On the other hand, conventional ones, with square or rectangular cores, are more economical but less efficient and can generate more vibrations.
Both perform the same electrical transformation function, but are preferred in different applications depending on space, noise and final cost requirements.
Do you want to have a look at our different transformers? Then just click here. If you need a recommendation or more specific advice, you can contact us here.

https://grupotorivac.com/

Access to this Web Site may involve the use of cookies. Cookies are small amounts of information that are stored in the browser used by each User -in the different devices that can be used to navigate- so that the server remembers certain information that later and only the server that implemented it will read. Cookies make browsing easier, more user-friendly, and do not damage the browsing device.

The information collected through cookies may include the date and time of visits to the Web Site, the pages viewed, the time spent on the Web Site and the sites visited just before and just after the same. However, no cookie allows this cookie to contact the User’s telephone number or any other means of personal contact. No cookie can extract information from the User’s hard drive or steal personal information. The only way for the User’s private information to be part of the Cookie file is for the User to personally give that information to the server.

Cookies that allow a person to be identified are considered personal data. Therefore, the Privacy Policy described above shall apply to them. In this sense, the use of cookies requires the consent of the User. This consent will be communicated, on the basis of a genuine choice, offered by means of an affirmative and positive decision, before the initial processing, removable and documented.
